name: codex-inner-edit
description: Generate read-only Python edit proposals for explicit Enter approval in Codex Inner IDE.

interface.shortDescription: Propose Python edits for Enter approval in Inner IDE.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to the active Python buffer in Codex Inner IDE, creates a read-only proposal, and waits for the user to accept it with Enter. Source code is not returned to the originating task.
defaultPrompt: Optimize the selected Python code in Codex Inner IDE.
Fix the active Python file and show an approval diff.
Refactor the current Python selection without saving it.
